name: blueprint
description: Practical system design and engineering judgment: requirements, invariants, failure behavior, and the simplest sufficient implementation.

interface.longDescription: Practical engineering judgment for requirements, data and API contracts, invariants, failure behavior, and technical trade-offs. Adapt the depth to the risk and complete implementation with relevant verification. Design and review requests remain read-only.
defaultPrompt: Use $blueprint to design and implement this change.
Use $blueprint to review this architecture without editing files.
